choose.when:
/* RealMapper.selectTotal 전체 현황 - 현재 시간 기준 */
SELECT ISNULL(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8), 4, 8), ':', ''), '00:00') AS IN_TIME , ISNULL(SUM(SEND_CNT), 0) AS SEND_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= GETDATE() AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -#{totalMonTime}, GETDATE())

mapper.select: /* RealMapper.selectRealHistServiceStatusSummaryList 서비스 / 프로세스 요약 */ WITH PROC_DATA AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%DBP%' THEN 'DBP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%IFP%' THEN 'IFP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%MEMMON%' THEN 'MON' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%STATP%' THEN 'SAP' ELSE 'ETC' END AS PROC_TYPE, COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, MIN(PROC_STS) AS PROC_STS, MIN(UPDATE_DATE) AS UPDATE_DATE FROM T_PROC_STATUS GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME ), STATUS_DATA AS ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, PROC_TYPE, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 'N' WHEN PROC_STS = 0 THEN 'F' WHEN PROC_STS = 1 THEN 'T' END AS FLAG FROM PROC_DATA ) SELECT COMPANY_CODE, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS DB_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS DB_DOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS DB_UNKNOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS IFP_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS IFP_DOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS IFP_UNKNOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS MON_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS MON_DOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS MON_UNKNOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS SAP_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS SAP_DOWN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS SAP_UNKNOWN_COUNT FROM STATUS_DATA GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE

/* RealMapper.selectRealHistServiceStatusDetailList 서비스 / 프로세스 상세 */ SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME, PROC_TYPE , DB_SESH_CHK, DB_SESH_STS, DB_UPDATE_DATE_STS , KT_SESH_CHK, KT_SESH_STS, KT_UPDATE_DATE_STS , SW_DOWN_CHK, SW_DOWN_STS, SW_UPDATE_DATE_STS FROM ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME, CASE WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%DBP%' THEN 'DBP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%IFP%' THEN 'IFP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%MEMMON%' THEN 'MON' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%STATP%' THEN 'SAP' END AS PROC_TYPE, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 THEN 1 END), 9999) AS DB_SESH_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS DB_SESH_STS, MIN(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS DB_UPDATE_DATE_STS, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 THEN 2 END), 9999) AS KT_SESH_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS KT_SESH_STS, MIN(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS KT_UPDATE_DATE_STS, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 THEN 3 END), 9999) AS SW_DOWN_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS SW_DOWN_STS, MIN(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS SW_UPDATE_DATE_STS FROM T_PROC_STATUS GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME ) T ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE
